_comment: Copy this file to scripts.json and edit it. It maps a script/edition name
to the roles it contains, which lets you:
Role names are matched loosely, so "Snake Charmer", "snakecharmer" and
"Snake_Charmer" all refer to the same role. A role may appear on several
scripts. Names not present in roles.json or custom_roles.json are skipped
with a warning. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
import_script.py adds scripts here for you from the official script tool.
